title: HARK: Relationship Safety Questions
about: Four yes or no questions about a partner or ex-partner in the past year (Humiliation, Afraid, Rape, Kick). One point for each yes; 1 or more is a positive screen for intimate partner violence. Give it when the patient is alone, never with a partner present.

code.display: Humiliation, Afraid, Rape, and Kick questionnaire

source.name: HARK, Sohal, Eldridge and Feder, BMC Family Practice 2007 (Table 1)

blocks.label: These questions are about a partner or ex-partner. Please answer them on your own, and check Yes or No for each.
items: Within the last year, have you been humiliated or emotionally abused in other ways by your partner or your ex-partner?
Within the last year, have you been afraid of your partner or ex-partner?
Within the last year, have you been raped or forced to have any kind of sexual activity by your partner or ex-partner?
Within the last year, have you been kicked, hit, slapped or otherwise physically hurt by your partner or ex-partner?

blocks.text: Published cut-offs (Sohal 2007): 1 or more, positive screen for intimate partner violence in the past year. Give this form when the patient is alone. For a positive screen, follow the clinic's protocol: talk with the patient privately, and offer support and local resources.
